name.zh: 黑铁一辉对比翼爱德怀斯

periods.summary: At Akatsuki's base, Ikki faces Edelweiss, the world's strongest swordswoman, so Shizuku can continue to Alice. He activates Ittou Shura immediately and uses Perfect Vision and his secret swords, but Edelweiss's silent dual-blade swordsmanship overwhelms him, counters Dokuga no Tachi, and shatters Intetsu. Ikki continues with the broken blade because Shizuku entrusted him with her wish. Edelweiss acknowledges him as a man and swordsman, fights seriously, and defeats him; however, his final attack leaves a few drops of her blood.
periods.cause: Edelweiss is lodging at Akatsuki and blocks intruders out of courtesy; Ikki refuses to let her follow Shizuku.
periods.outcome: Ikki survives due to his final counter disrupting Edelweiss's killing stroke; Kurono arrives, heals him, and later relays Edelweiss's wish to meet him again as a rival.
periods.significance: Marks Ikki's first encounter with the world's summit and proves he can leave a wound even on Edelweiss.
